name: pcc-android-mirror
description: Android packaging (Capacitor) for the standalone 'At a Glance' mirror app (../../mirror-app). Wraps mirror-app's self-contained index.html in its own native WebView shell, distinct applicationId (com.pcc.projectcontrolcenter.mirror) so it installs alongside the main Project Control Center app on the same device -- dev-only tooling, not part of either shipped single-file app.

scripts.android:sync: node scripts/copy-app.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:build:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
